test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution: The correct answer is **"feelings."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"feelings"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. • It refers to emotions or sensations experienced by a person. (शरीर या मन की अनुभूति; अहसास, भावना) • **Example**: *My toes were so cold that I lost all **feeling**__ in them.* • Grammatically, it is a noun and fits well in the sentence. • The correct answer is Option 1. • Correct passage: Isolation and loneliness __caused__ by the Covid-19 pandemic and lockdown policies negatively __impacted__ the mental health of the public throughout the entire globe. These result in an increase in emotional __stress__, __**feelings**__ of hopelessness and extreme anxiety, which are ______ (5) ______ by variations in emotional responses and style of living. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2 (notion) **refers to a general understanding or belief about something. (मन में कोई बात, ख़याल; विचार, धारणा) • **Option 3 (idea)** refers to a thought or suggestion about a possible course of action. (योजना, विचार या सुझाव (विशेषतः इस बारे में कि स्थिति विशेष में क्‍या किया जाए)) • **Option 4 (concept)** refers to an abstract idea or general notion. (विचार; मूल सिद्घांत) 1e7:Tbbe, The correct answer is** "accompanied."**
